name: Silver Gene ~The Mutia Chronicle 1~
original_name: シルバージーン ～the mutia chronicle 1～
source:
I will not forget those eyes. 
A funny cat-ears girl Mi is picked up at a garbage dump. 
She lost all her memory. 
I search for clues to regain Mi's memory. 
A silver gene of Mi gets her hunted by a mysterious organization. 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/02/vn-of-month-march-2001.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
我不会忘记那双眼睛。

一名长着猫耳、性格古怪的女孩美，在垃圾场被人捡到。她失去了全部记忆。

我开始寻找恢复美的记忆的线索。由于美体内拥有银色基因，她遭到了神秘组织的追捕。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/02/vn-of-month-march-2001.html]vndbreview[/url]]
